description: This file defines custom Cypress commands for end-to-end testing of the OrangeHRM application, including login, API login, element retrieval, toast messages, input setting, validation checks, and option selection.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs a login by visiting the login page, entering username and password, and submitting the form.

methods.name: loginTo
methods.description: Performs a login to a specified URL with given credentials, with optional additional visit options.

methods.name: apiLogin
methods.description: Performs an API-based login by sending a POST request with credentials.

methods.name: getOXD
methods.description: Retrieves an element from the OXD_ELEMENTS object based on type.

methods.name: getOXDInput
methods.description: Finds an input element based on its label and logs associated details.

methods.name: toast
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a toast message of a specific type with the given message.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of an input or textarea element and dispatches an input event.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks whether an input is marked as invalid with a specific message.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects an option within a dropdown or select element.
